title_en: Hey, I Took a Very Young Wife
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional humorous song. 'Гарагачка' (magpie) and 'зелник' (a savory pie, here the place or dish) are my reading; the last verses are a joke about the new bride not knowing household things.
